original: ��������Sorry to keep you waiting, Lord\nVamdemon.
This is a good spot to make our\nbase.
Now we just have to deal with the\neighth Chosen Child. Find them as\nsoon as possible.
Yes, sir!
Yes, sir!
Morning! Seems like there was an\nawful commotion around here.
They've been talking about it\nnonstop on the morning news.
So the only one we're still\nwaiting for would be...
Just Jou.
What's he up to, anyway?
Let's wait until he gets here.
It's been a while since I've been\nable to play soccer. I pulled off\nsome nice dribbles.
Even though you haven't been near\na ball in so long?
Yeah! All that training in the\nDigital World must have made me a\nbetter athlete.
Did you improve at soccer too,\nSora?
I dunno. I haven't been able to\nget to a ball lately, so I really\nhave no idea.
I wanna play soccer, too!
Okay, then let's have a match\nsomeday!
Yeah, sounds fun!
Soccer really is fun.
It's a nice day out today. On a\nday like this, I want to go out\nfor a drive and play some music...
Is your dad busy with his job?
Would you take some lunch, too?
Yeah, he comes home and then goes\nright back.
But I guess that's not really a\nbad thing...
Haha!
Yamatoooooo, I wanna ride in a car\ntoo!
Well, if we have time, we'll take\nyou driving.
Yay!
B-U-T! Only if you're Tsunomon!
We'd get into a pretty awkward\nsituation if I made lunch.
The busier he gets, the more my\ndad pressures me about it...
S-sorry. That wasn't very cool of\nme, saying something like that...
My dad's going to be up all night\ntonight, too...
Ever since we got home, I've been\nbusy performing maintenance on my\ncomputer.
Is it that important to you?
I couldn't repair anything in the\nDigimon world, after all...let\nalone find replacement parts.
We're all the way here in the\nhuman world, but I've been stuck\nin his room the whole time...
Sorry, Tentomon.
You really like computers, don't\nyou, Koushirou?
Yes. Would you consider that\nstrange?
It's not strange at all!
It might be a bit unusual...
I-is that so? That makes me kind\nof happy.
Your computer was a really huge\nhelp back when we were in the\nDigimon world.
It's a privilege to be of\nassistance.
I thought so...
Don't worry about it. It's good\nfor people to be a little unique.
Ahaha...
I should buy a new computer soon.\nHmm...
There really is no place like\nhome! I have food here and a nice,\ncool room!
And when you open the fridge,\nthere's cola!
Mimi, you haven't even left the\nhouse once since we got back.
You're tired from all that walking\nin the Digimon world, aren't you?
I'm staying home this summer\nvacation! I won't take a single\nstep out the door!
Aren't you gonna get fat?
Not even if you were going overseas?
You're right.
You have to exercise, at least a\nlittle. How about soccer?
Ehhhhhhhhhhh, I'd prefer a more\ncasual sport.
Okay, then maybe I'd leave! If we\nwere going to Hawaii or something.
Hawaii's by the ocean, so you'll\nhave the chance to move around.
Nah, I wanna drink juice and lie\non the beach...
Ahaha, but that's not very\ndifferent from what you'd do at\nhome.
But it's a good idea! I'll ask\nPapa.
I'm spending my summer vacation\nrelaxing! This really is the best.
Sora! I'm gonna spend my vacation\nplaying at my grandma's house!
Oh, wow! Where does she live?
She lives in Shimane.
Is Patamon coming with you?
Where's Shimane?
Yeah! Takeru's taking me with him.
It'll be your first time in an\nairplane, right?
Of course! Being in a flying\nvehicle sounds fun.
Haha, sounds fun.
It'll be lots of fun! I'm sure\nyou'll be surprised, Patamon!
That's horrible, Sora!
I *should* know, but it looks like\nit's slipped my mind.
Really?
Really. Shimane... Shimane?
Hmph!
I wonder if Grandma's doing okay.
Heeeeeeeeeeeey!
Jou!
Sorry. I had a bit of a hard time\nfinding my old class roster.
Someone's clearly taking it easy.
The eighth child witnessed the\nDigimon incident in Hikarigaoka\nfour years ago, just like we did.
And furthermore, we should note\nthat they were in this area last\nnight.
Koushirou found a signal last\nnight.
For that reason, I believe that\ntoday we should split up and try\nsearching this area.
Got it!
That sounds good... even though\nit's burning hot out here.
So what should I do with the\nroster I found?
There's a high possibility that\nthe eighth child's name is in\nthere.
Please call each of them and ask\nthem if they were in Shibaura last\nnight.
I have summer classes starting\ntomorrow. I'll take care of the\nphone calls as soon as possible...
But let me stay home, instead of\ngoing out to look for them.
That's not fair, Jou!
I-I can't help it! I've got\nentrance exams!
Okay, then I'll give you my share\nas well. Here's the directory for\nWakaba Kindergarten.
Good idea! Here's the roster for\nFourth Elementary. Do a good job!
It may be better to leave this all\nto one person.
Sounds like a plan. I'll leave\nthis to you, Jou.
Hey, hey...Taichi, not you too?
Don't worry! I'm not gonna make\nother people do my work.
You're such a nice guy!
I bet he actually just couldn't\nfind his directory.
Okay! Let's split up and find the\neighth child!
Good luck, everyone.
Ugh... Okay then, good luck, guys.
Let's look together, Takeru.
Okay! I'll go with you, Yamato!
Mimi, let's go search for the\neighth child together.
Okaaaaaaay!
Where are you going, Tailmon?
To search for the eighth child.\nThat's our mission, right?
Trying to take all the credit,\nhuh? You're always like that.
What?!
I'm the one who found the clue to \nthe eighth child! So I get to \nsearch this place! It's only fair!
You think the eighth child is\nalways going to stay in one place?
If you think they've moved, then\ngo look somewhere else! Hahahaha!
Hmph! You're just a little bat\nwho's always trying to kiss up to\nVamdemon!
(Even when I was still in my Child\nform, Plotmon, Vamdemon always\nworked me to the bone.)
(And if anything went wrong, he\nwould beat me up...)
(Because he doesn't like my\neyes... I was born with them, I\ncan't help it...)
(Born... I don't even remember\nwhere I was born...)
(or what I was doing before I met\nVamdemon...)
Tailmon...
Ah!
Reminiscing on old times?
Wizarmon...
Didn't I tell you not to read my\nmind without my permission?
I apologize, I didn't mean to.
I'm going to go look for the\neighth child...
How are we supposed to look for\nthe eighth child?
For now, we should ask people if\nthey've ever lived in Hikarigaoka.
That sounds like a lot of work.
~30 minutes later~
Ah! There's a fast food joint over\nthere! Sora, why don't we rest up\nfor a bit?
We have to take this seriously,\nMimi.
Hmph...
~After another 30 minutes~
Why do I have to do this? We just\ngot home, and yet...
Sora, let's take a short break.
Can't be helped, I guess.
Last night I was in a room with a\nfluffy bed and air conditioning!
It's really great, being at\nhome...
And the food was delicious...
Yeah, yeah! It was the first time\nI ever thought Mama's cooking was\nso delicious.
The food at Sora's house was\ndelicious, too. Sora's mom seems\nlike a very nice person.
You think so? Thanks... Anyway,\nback to work, back to work...
Sora, why don't we go someplace\nwhere lots of people gather?
Where lots of people gather?
Mmmmm! It's so nice and cool! I\nlove being in places with air\nconditioning!
I *thought* you'd have an ulterior\nmotive...
Woooow! This place is really\ncrowded.
That's because it's a tourist\nattraction, you know.
Hey, Sora, your house is over\nhere, right?
Yeah. This is the world we live\nin.
Mimi, isn't it a bit hot?
Yeah. Maybe the air conditioning\ndoesn't work as well around here?
Is the air conditioner broken?
Aaaaaaaaaaah!
Gyaaaaaaaah!
It's a Digimon!
RAAAAAAAAAAARGH!
Sora!
The only thing we can do is fight\nhim, Mimi!
We did it!
Whew. We managed to make it out of\nthat one... somehow.
But to think he'd appear in a\ntourist attraction, with so many\npeople around.
Let's hurry. We have to find the\neighth child.
They're a peaceful lot...
Miko! Where are you, Miko? Where\nare you...?
Are you Agumon's friend?
Ah, wait!
How did she know about Agumon?\nCould she be the eighth child?
(I really don't think she's a\nnormal kid. Best to just get rid\nof her now.)
It's you again!
C'mere...
Are you gonna come back again?
There isn't enough evidence that\nshe's the eighth child.
But why? That child... why do I\nget this feeling?
I wonder if Jou's coming after all.
We should wait for him together.
